title: InferencePolicy
description: What an Agent / Flow agent node needs from a model — a *role* plus constraints, never a vendor. The Model Fabric resolves the policy to one ModelDefinition at call time (RoutingDecision); NexCore policy decides eligibility, the fabric only optimises inside the eligible set. `model_id` is allowed only with strategy=explicit and only where the effective Blueprint sets allow_explicit_model (validator warning: model_id_pinned).

strategy.description: Default cheapest_qualified: the lowest-tier eligible model whose quality[role] ≥ quality_min. quality_first: highest quality inside the eligible set. local_only: never leaves the deployment contour. explicit: `model_id` (Developer mode).

quality_min.description: Minimum benchmark score for `role` (ModelDefinition.benchmarks[role]). Absent = Blueprint default for the role.

languages.description: BCP-47 tags the model must support (e.g. uk, en). Rejection reason: language.

capabilities.description: Required capabilities (tool_calling, structured_output, vision …). Rejection reason: capability.

max_tier.description: Highest Inference Ladder tier this step may reach (0 = no generative model … 4 = frontier). Blueprints may only lower it.

escalation.description: Allow the schema-failure ladder: on invalid structured output retry once with a repair prompt, then the next eligible tier, then fail/human. Default false.

retention.description: 1.114.0: the retention mode of the content this call carries. `session_only` — a shared-screen frame or a session-only file — excludes every egress provider that does not declare `retention=none` (the refusal is `retention`, visible on the route line; no silent fallback).

model_id.description: Only with strategy=explicit. Never a provider secret or endpoint.
